entries.text:
# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Naro noncamantaqueterra, Aparioshi, camicitaqueria Viro pitomidakena narunocama táqueri narotáqui noneaquitémbira y nungamagitaquébmira Viro. Pineaquékuadlin Buisama quentequi bai.
